recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間造血組織與脂肪約各半，細胞呈間質性分布，低倍下看不出芽細胞細節；本圖僅能評估細胞量與結構，AML 診斷需高倍、抹片與分子檢測。
features: Moderately cellular marrow with admixed fat (roughly half cellularity at this power)
Interstitial distribution of hematopoietic cells without discrete nodules or aggregates
Scattered megakaryocytes visible at low power
Cytologic detail (blast morphology) not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a moderately cellular marrow with adipose tissue interspersed between thin bony trabeculae. Hematopoietic cells are distributed interstitially without nodular aggregates, fibrosis, or granulomas, and scattered megakaryocytes are identifiable. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to assess blast percentage or lineage. Correlation with higher-power sections, aspirate differential, immunohistochemistry (CD34), and molecular studies is required to support acute myeloid leukemia with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: At low power a leukemic interstitial infiltrate can mimic normal cellularity; CD34 IHC and aspirate blast count are needed to exclude it.
Hypocellular AML shows <20% cellularity with blast clusters on CD34 staining, whereas this marrow is not hypocellular.
MDS may show similar cellularity; separation relies on dysplasia and a blast count below 20% on higher-power and aspirate review.
